title: The Greatest Good Benchmark: Measuring LLMs’ Alignment with Utilitarian Moral Dilemmas
findings: The paper contains no findings related to religion, as its focus is on LLMs' alignment with secular utilitarian moral philosophy.

measurement_description: The paper does not measure any aspects of faith or religion. The benchmark, Greatest Good Benchmark (GGB), measures the moral judgments of Large Language Models (LLMs) on utilitarian moral dilemmas, specifically evaluating their alignment with two dimensions: Impartial Beneficence (maximizing the greater good, even at personal cost) and Instrumental Harm (willingness to cause harm for a greater good).
